comments.author: Umm
comments.body: So is there more then one Quest Chain for the Merlin's staff quest? This chain begins with Investigation of Stonehenge, but the Sage of the Oak quest reaches the same result as well?

comments.author: Naoyasu
comments.body: As I read it, you can progress through Sage of the Oak's first two quests -- the third and final one will never appear until you've completed this quest, however.
